Imagine Black Friday... forever. Every store, ninety percent off. Every single day. It never ends.
A TV for nine dollars? I'll take ten!
Why stop at ten? Take eleven!
Week two. You can't see the floor anymore. Just boxes.
Week three. Dad sleeps in a tent outside the store. Every single night.
If they restock, at least I'm on time!
Week four. Your dog has forty-seven beds. He still sleeps on the floor.
Fun fact. The name Black Friday came from police in Philadelphia.
Not these crowds again. What a black Friday!
Christmas. You open your present. It's a TV. You already have eleven.
Month six. The stores sold everything for almost nothing. One by one, they close.
Then Dad finds the last store on Earth. One phone. Full price: a thousand dollars.
A thousand dollars?! That's a scam!
Don't worry, sir. Tomorrow is Cyber Monday. Forever.
